shortDescription.default: A compact React and Copilot negotiation practice with SharePoint-backed state.

longDescription.default: Two SPFx Copilot components keep a current practice board available while Copilot answers questions or previews counterpart offers. APVEE provisions two simple SharePoint lists; questions write nothing, and only explicit React actions submit or accept terms.

features.title: Negotiation Lab
features.description: Activates the Negotiation Lab components and declarative agent.
